acip: BDAG GI MING THOS NAS, BDAG GI MTHUS LAS KYI SGRIB PA ZAD PAR GYUR NAS, BYANG CHUB KYI MTHAR THUG GI BAR DU, YANG DAG PA'I LTA BA CAN DU GYUR CIG
wylie: bdag gi ming thos nas, bdag gi mthus las kyi sgrib pa zad par gyur nas, byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du, yang dag pa'i lta ba can du gyur cig
english: But when they hear my name, then by my mystic power may all their karmic obstacles come to an end; and up until the day of their own final enlightenment, may they always come to have a correct view of things.
